summary: Ownership and STARTED are durable, but post-claim validation proved the required representative_javascript_browser capability unavailable in the invocable runtime. The installed agent-browser skill describes a browser CLI, while the local runtime has no agent-browser executable. The connected Vercel surface exposes browser-capable sandbox commands only for an existing session; worker-lab currently has zero named sandboxes and zero sessions, and this connection exposes no session/sandbox creation primitive. HTTP/search retrieval is explicitly non-representative, so no served-browser PASS was fabricated.
